verdict.rationale: Simular's docs say Sai works across the entire operating system, covering desktop apps, browsers, file systems and terminals. Its open-source framework controls computers through the UI, keyboard and mouse, and it runs on cloud Windows machines or the user's own macOS/Windows device. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, explicit documentation of keyboard-shortcut handling.

support.subject: As a power user, the agent operates desktop applications (click, type, keyboard shortcuts) across the whole OS, not one walled app

citations.quote: Sai works across your entire operating system: desktop apps, web browsers, file systems, and terminals, the way a human would.
An open-source framework for agents that control computers like a human — UI, keyboard, and mouse — across environments.
Your agent can then get things done where there is no API: web apps behind a login, admin consoles, desktop software, forms with no import.
Sai's BYOD supports devices including Mac mini, macOS and Windows.
